doc.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017

title: Reasons for firing band members
summary: Drugs, lack of focus and personality problems lead him to let players go.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: What would cause you to give someone the pink slip?

Well there was one guy who — really into drugs. I saw so many guys pretty much get ruined by getting too much into drugs or getting too — there was a trombone player, I won’t mention his name, who was a real entrepreneur. I mean he sold drugs and he was very busy. And guys were coming to him to make a connection or something. So it was interfering with — he wasn’t concentrating on the music. That was one. And you’ve got to be in tune with the guys in the band you know. I mean I had an 8-piece group, and everybody had to pretty much understand what we were to accomplish you know. A couple of guys had other stuff going and you could tell they weren’t really interested, and so that to me was a — I mean we still are friends and everything but I said, “Go do your thing, but I’ve got to concentrate on this little circle of stuff here.” So it’s a function of concentration or where you put all of your effort. And there are other people that you just don’t get along with them.
Yeah. There’s a chemistry to maintain with a number of people like that.

Yeah and there are guys that are just bastards. There was a drummer that played too loud. And you say something to him and people are very, very, very particular about how they play. And you’ve got to be really careful. Like don’t say, too many notes, or not enough notes, or the guy isn’t reading the charts. There was one, a drummer that, I mean he could read but he had to get the arrangements. We were doing some stuff by Louie Bellson and that. And that’s pretty heavy drum stuff. And I said, “Look, just spend a little time with it. I do it.” I said, “I’m not this hotshot at reading, I’m probably the worst reader in the damn band.” But if we get a new tune and I need to spend some time with it or concentrate, I do it. So there’s different things that would cause you to —
